{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid ReServe''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] remainder reseller that sold inventory from [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc./Legends|Serv-O-Droid]] after the company was liquidated by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. The reseller was located on [[Elshandruu Pica]] and had millions of new droids in its inventory. For [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the liquidation of Serv-O-Droid, the Droid ReServe continued to produce the company's droids and replacement parts.<ref name="SGtD">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
